guidanceConsulted.query: style text ranges with the CSS Custom Highlight API
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Only a limited property set applies inside ::highlight(); don't rely on colour alone (pair with an underline style) and keep 4.5:1 contrast; custom highlights are presentational, so use <mark> for semantically meaningful text; feature-detect and provide a fallback.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied in the page's examples: the base example pairs colour with text-decoration styles, uses dark text on light highlight backgrounds, the prose tells readers to use <mark> for meaningful text, and a @supports selector(::highlight(*)) / not-selector fallback block is shown. The guide's 'not exposed to the accessibility tree' wording was checked against css-highlight-api-1 §highlight-types (UAs SHOULD expose highlights by Highlight.type) and the page states the spec position instead.

guidanceConsulted.query: lazy load sandboxed cross-origin iframe embed responsively (no direct guide matched; nearest results local-network-access/security/performance)
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: No iframe-specific guide matched. Applied the house pattern: wide tables in .table-wrap (overflow-x:auto) so they scroll in place rather than forcing page overflow; iframe width:100% with loading=lazy.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap on all tables, compat-table min-width with normal word-breaking inside its scroller, iframe width:100%/max-width:100%, loading=lazy, sandbox + referrerpolicy pair per gendn-kjq.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless Chrome 153, 1280x800 and 360x740: documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth on both, iframe frame title resolved to the showcase concept, zero console errors and zero failed requests; screenshots read.
